_comment: Where a project's worktree links are read from, as one table both
implementations are checked against. `aide-run-spec` (bash) and the dashboard's
assessProjectReadiness() (TypeScript) resolve this independently — the pair is
hand-kept, like WORKFLOW_STEPS and DEPENDENCY_GATED_STEPS, so the agreement is
`links` is what both sides must resolve to. `source` is what both sides
report when a value is read — the dashboard's readiness check has no source
field to report, so its test reads the `links` column only.
null means: the key is not written in that file at all.
